South Tahoe Transit Joint Powers Authority
                              Meeting Agenda
                    Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 9:30 am
    City Hall - Council Chambers - 1901 Lisa Maloff Way, South Lake Tahoe

South Tahoe Transit Joint Powers Authority
Brooke Laine, El Dorado County Board of Supervisors- Chair
Cody Bass, City Councilmember- Vice Chair
Keith Roberts, City Councilmember



Public Participation
South Tahoe Transit JPA Board meetings are held in person at the time and location listed on this agenda.
A public agenda packet is available for review at City Hall, 1901 Lisa Maloff Way, on the City’s Website at
www.cityofslt.us, or by contacting the City Clerk's Office, (530) 542-6005 or sblankenship@cityofslt.us
Public Comment provided in person: Every agenda for regular meetings provides an opportunity for members
of the public to directly address the JPA Board on any item on the agenda or in connection with any item which
the South Tahoe Transit JPA Board will consider. The public is given the opportunity to comment before or
during the South Tahoe Transit JPA Board’s consideration of the item [Government Code Section 54954.3(a)].

In Writing: Written comments received by 3 p.m. the day before the meeting will be distributed to South Tahoe
Transit JPA Board prior to the meeting. Written public comment regarding any item on this agenda may be
sent to PublicComment@cityofslt.us. When emailing comments, identify the agenda item number in the subject
line to which your comments relate. Any such comment that is a public record and is emailed to
PublicComment@cityofslt.us or otherwise provided to a majority of the South Tahoe Transit JPA Board before
the meeting will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at the City Clerk's Office
located at City Hall, 1901 Lisa Maloff Way, South Lake Tahoe [Government Code Section 54957.5(b)]. Written
comments will not be read out loud during the meeting.

The meeting facility is accessible to people with disabilities. Every reasonable effort will be made to
accommodate any person needing special assistance to attend this meeting. Contact the City Clerk at (530)
542-6005 at least 48 hours in advance of the meeting for assistance [28 CFR 35.102.35.104 ADA Title II and
Brown Act Government Code Sections 54953.2, 54954.1, 54954.2, and 54957.5].

Call to Order/Pledge of Allegiance

Roll Call

Public Communications
This is the public's opportunity to speak on any topic NOT LISTED on this agenda. Comments shall be
limited to four (4) minutes. In accordance with the Brown Act, the South Tahoe Transit JPA cannot
deliberate or vote on any matter raised under public communications, but may briefly respond to
statements made or questions posed. (Government Code Sections 54954.2)

Consent Agenda

                   Board Report
Meeting Date: October 29, 2026

Title: Fiscal Year 2026/2027 Meeting Calendar

Action: Pass a resolution adopting the Fiscal Year 2026/2027 JPA regular Board
meeting calendar

Issue and Discussion: The proposed regular meeting calendar includes quarterly
meetings. Although regular meetings are proposed, they may be cancelled or special
meetings scheduled on an as needed basis.

Meetings will begin at 9:30 a.m. and be held in the City Council Chambers at the Lake
Tahoe Airport. All meetings are proposed to be held in person only.

Environmental Considerations: Adopting the meeting calendar is not a project subject
to
review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under CEQA Guidelines
section 15378(5) (organizational or administrative activities that will not result in direct or
indirect physical changes to the environment)

Financial Implications: There are no financial obligations associated with this action.




Transit JPA Board Report              October 29, 2026                            Page 1 of 1

South Tahoe Transit Joint Powers Authority
                       (JPA)
                   Board Report
Meeting Date: October 29, 2026

Title: Tahoe Transit Funding Memo Presentation
Action: Receive presentation

Background: TRPA staff, in collaboration with regional transit partners, initiated the
Tahoe Transit Study in late 2025 to help create a more coordinated, efficient, and
sustainable transit system through the Tahoe Basin. The multi-stage planning process
will consist of a transit governance study, regional comprehensive operational analysis,
and optimized transit funding model. Planning efforts will utilize and build upon recently
completed transit and transportation plans including TTD’s Short Range Transit Plan
(adopted January 2025), Placer County’s Tahoe Truckee Area Regional Transit Systems
Plan Update (adopted November 2025), and the Connections 2050: Regional
Transportation Plan (adopted July 2025).

The Tahoe Transit Study and deliverables will be overseen by the Transit Working
Group, which is an informal collaborative body dedicated to addressing local and
regional transit issues within the Lake Tahoe Basin. The Transit Working Group is
facilitated by TRPA staff and has staff level representatives from each local jurisdiction,
TTD, the South Shore Transportation Management Association (SSTMA), and the
Truckee North Tahoe Transportation Management Association (TNT/TMA).

Issue and Discussion: TRPA Staff will present an analysis from the Funding Memo
and provide information on additional deliverables and the project timeline. Project
information is available at www.trpa.gov/transitstudy .

Environmental Considerations: Receiving a presentation is not a project requiring
environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under
CEQA Guidelines section 15378(b)(5) (organizational or administrative activities that will
not result in direct or indirect physical changes to the environment).

Financial Implications: None.

South Tahoe Transit JPA              October 29, 2026

South Tahoe Transit Joint Powers Authority
                       (JPA)
                   Board Report
Meeting Date: October 29, 2026

Title: South Tahoe Transit JPA Fiscal Year 2026/2027 Budget

Action: Pass a resolution approving the Fiscal Year 2026/2027 Budget (October 1,
2026 through September 30, 2027) South Tahoe Transit JPA Budget and directing staff
to send requests to the City of South Lake Tahoe and El Dorado County to submit
funding to the JPA.

Background: The JPA adopted the FY 25/26 budget on October 30, 2026 and directed
the Executive Director to submit requests for funding to El Dorado County and the City
of South Lake Tahoe. El Dorado County did not approve the $25,775 requested budget
allocation. The City approved allocation of $51,551. With that allocation, the Transit JPA
was able to meet three times in the 25/26 fiscal year to discuss priorities and
engagement in regional planning processes.

Issue and Discussion: The City as the Managing Agency has developed a cost
estimate for administrative costs for Fiscal Year 2026/2027 (Resolution Exhibit A). The
cost estimate includes the following assumptions:
     that the Assistant City Manager will be designated as the Executive Director and
       10% of their time will be dedicated to the JPA;
     5% of the City Finance Director’s time will be dedicated to serving as the JPA
       Treasurer;
     5% of the City Clerk’s time will be dedicated to serving as the JPA Secretary;
     The Transit JPA Board will meet quarterly
     Legal counsel costs for the period will not exceed $10,000;
     Financial Officer Bond premium costs will not exceed $5,000; and
     The Transit JPA will not require indemnification or liability insurance due to not
       proceeding with directly operating transit this fiscal year.

Expenses are anticipated to be limited to administrative costs incurred by the City as the
Managing Agency totaling $67,326. To reflect the makeup of the JPA Board
representation, it is recommended that 2/3 of the total cost be attributed to the City and
1/3 to the County.

                                                    Amount
                      City of South Lake Tahoe      $44,884
                      El Dorado County              $22,442
                      Total                         $67,326

These costs are based generally on the following 2026/2027 Transit JPA activities:
    Implementing an advocacy approach for JPA adopted goals and priorities

Transit JPA Board Report            October 29, 2026                          Page 1 of 2

South Tahoe Transit Joint Powers Authority
                         (JPA)
                     Board Report
      Securing JPA financial officer surety bond
      Continued coordination and discussion with other agencies
      Participating in the Lake Tahoe Transit Working Group to conduct a
       comprehensive operational analysis of transit services in the region.

Environmental Considerations: The approval of a budget is not a project requiring
environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under
CEQA Guidelines section 15378(b)(5) (organizational or administrative activities that will
not result in direct or indirect physical changes to the environment).

Financial Implications: Approval of the budget will create financial obligations for both
the City and County to cover administrative costs of the JPA.
